title: how to add blog search and category navigation
text:
Adding search and category navigation help in building better SEO hierarchy on the content, it allows users to scan and better understand the content on Blog. 

How to add Search and Category Navigation for Blog?
Go to Sites > Blogs
Once you go to Blogs from the list, click on the name of blog and in the list view of blog there is option to Edit the Site
After going to specific blog site editor, there will be option of in Elements of Category Navigation. 
Drag and drop the Category Navigation element
While editing, it allows user to add more category in navigation. For Example, click on the Category 1 to edit the Category name and link to the category associated with the blog post. Please do the similar to other category options too. 
For Adding the Blog Search, there is option to enable or disable.
